title: Spicy Beef Tagine with Morcilla
description: A hearty and flavorful tagine made with beef, morcilla, and spices, inspired by the rich culinary traditions of Ethiopia. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high. Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove beef from pot.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger to pot. Cook until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper to pot. Cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste to pot. Cook for 1 minute.
Add beef broth and honey to pot. Stir to combine.
Return beef to pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours.
Add morcilla to pot. Simmer for an additional 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
